===={{aniseries|DP}}====
Palmer made his {{pkmn|animated series}} debut in ''[[DP140|Historical Mystery Tour!]]'', where he arrived in [[Twinleaf Town]] and met up with his son {{an|Barry}}. He revealed that he had also visited [[Xatu's Forest]], and informed his son of the importance of looking to the past and its connection to the future.

Palmer was revealed to be visiting his [[hometown]] to attend the [[Twinleaf Festival]]. There, a battle tournament known as the [[Festival Battle Challenge]] was being held to determine which {{pkmn|Trainer}} would be given the opportunity to battle the {{tc|Tower Tycoon|head}} of [[Sinnoh]]'s {{si|Battle Tower}} and the strongest of the Sinnoh [[Frontier Brain]]s. Ash won the tournament in ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'' and had his battle with Palmer. Even though Ash lost, Palmer still gave him a trophy as recognition for winning the tournament. Palmer later suggested Ash challenge the [[Gym]] located in [[Sunyshore City]] and hinted about the unmotivated {{gy|Sunyshore}} [[Gym Leader]], [[Volkner]].
